scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: landmark, list, current page, folding, keyboard, resolver

limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Breadcrumb with ui-breadcrumb at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 gap, ellipsis and label limit derive from u; 3 the caret uses icon size sm; 4 text links, so no construction pattern; 5 no border; 6 the ellipsis takes u × scale; 7 the label role; 8 the 1u gap is fixed; 9 no floating layer; 10 long crumbs truncate at 40u and the trail wraps, and the caret mirrors in RTL; 11 the kit's focus ring on links and the ellipsis.
